titre: Mandatory vaccinations and check-ups at the PMI
resume: The vaccines required for daycare, school and holiday clubs, the recommendations specific to Mayotte, and check-ups for children under 6 at the PMI, run by the Département.
aQuoiCaSert: Mandatory vaccinations are required to start daycare, school, after-school care or holiday camp: without proof, enrollment may be refused or only temporary. The proof is the child's health record book (carnet de santé) filled in by the doctor. The PMI (protection maternelle et infantile, the mother and child health service), which in Mayotte is run by the Département (the local council), provides consultations for pregnant women and young children, vaccinations included.
quiEstConcerne: All parents of minor children, especially before starting daycare, school or a holiday club.
Parents of newborns, for the vaccines recommended from birth in Mayotte.
aSavoir: Child born before 2018: diphtheria, tetanus and polio (DTP) are mandatory for school.

Child born between January 1, 2018 and December 31, 2022: 11 mandatory vaccines (diphtheria, tetanus, polio, whooping cough, Haemophilus influenzae b, hepatitis B, pneumococcus, meningococcus C, measles, mumps, rubella).
Child born in 2023 or later: same list, with meningococcus A, B, C, W and Y instead of meningococcus C alone.
These requirements apply in Mayotte; the ARS Mayotte (regional health agency) is also promoting stronger recommendations against whooping cough.
A child who is not up to date can be admitted provisionally: you then have 3 months to catch up, otherwise the child may be excluded.

The child is entitled to 20 mandatory health check-ups from birth to age 16 (16 before age 6), covered 100% with no upfront payment, excluding extra fees charged by the doctor (dépassements d'honoraires).
Separated parents: the parent who takes the child to be vaccinated should inform the other parent and send them a copy of the vaccination pages.
